title: NP-hardness of serialized 3-CNF satisfiability
statement: Let $\mathrm{SAT}_3$ be the language of bit strings whose decoded CNF formula is satisfiable and has at most three literals in every clause. Every language in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to $\mathrm{SAT}_3$.
